evidence: The task is clearly authored for its product. instruction.md:1-3 is a first-person request from 'Kittle & Rowe', a small law firm, with reasons ('clients keep emailing documents to whoever answered last'; 'a leak is a professional-conduct problem'). The domain core is ethical walls, disappearing-message timers measured against a fixed clock, partner-only legal holds and matter transcripts (walls-and-retention.md), and nothing in it reads as generic chat with renamed nouns. Seed data uses matters M-11/M-12/M-13 and roles partner/associate/client. Dev is walled from M-12. The criteria are domain-specific. Functional judge.toml has 16 criteria, including signin_and_client_scope, wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live, deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release and search_and_transcript. These carry about 27 of 44 weight units. Visual includes retention_marks, transcript_page and phone_chambers; polish includes transcript_print. Closest sibling: projects/threadline-chat (webdev/threadline-chat, an older Slack-style team chat in the retired tests/rubric layout). Its 24 criteria are about channels, DMs, reactions, pins, presence/typing, webhooks, pagination and audit. Generic chat mechanics overlap: stale-edit refusal, mention edit correction, idempotent send, message links, per-user unread. Kittle reframes each of these around walls and retention. For example, link previews say 'not available' to walled users, mentions are suppressed for walled people, and deleted text must not reappear through quotes, versions or transcripts. The two task shapes, entity models and core promises differ, so this is not a nouns-swapped clone. Domain plan: task.toml category 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' matches the handoff plan (KITTLE_BUILD_CONTEXT.txt:12). It is the only task in projects/ with that category, and the only one in the workspace with ethical walls or legal hold (grep across */instruction.md). No sibling residue: a grep of the frozen task for colderwater/threadline/hireops/ridgeline/docketlight/channel/webhook/reaction/SKU finds only template gate boilerplate ('empty workspace', which also appears in the template's constraints prompt.md:9) and a local variable named 'candidate' in server.js. The shared checker-not-fixer and gate paragraphs are house template text, not cloning. Adversarial angle: no broken app or conforming alternative changes this row's outcome. It is a source-level judgement about authorship and distinctness, and it needs no runtime measurement. Other rows judge runtime grading quality.
